subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding cross-sections created by slicing three-dimensional solids
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student virtually slices a 3D solid at different angles and observes the resulting 2D cross-section shape
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a slicing plane to the correct resulting cross-section shape
exercise.abstract: Student predicts the cross-section shape resulting from a described slice of a solid

misconception_flags: assumes every slice of a solid produces the same cross-section shape regardless of angle or direction

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
